job.title: Senior Android Engineer
job.description: Build secure, privacy-focused native Android applications using Kotlin, Maestro, and Graphite. Responsibilities include developing Android features, improving autofill, supporting Privacy Pro, and enhancing phishing and malware protection. The role requires end-to-end project ownership, effective UX collaboration using quantitative and qualitative data, creative problem-solving, and clear communication across cross-functional teams.
